checks.note: The per-drill loop in handleBookingCompleted catches only DataIntegrityViolationException; any other exception from perDrillTx.execute (erasure-guard lock, saveAndFlush, transient DB error) escapes the loop, the finally publishes only already-committed drills, and the @Async void AFTER_COMMIT listener drops the exception with no retry. The NOWAIT internals of isErasedUnderLock aren't shown, but the verdict doesn't depend on them — any non-duplicate-key failure suffices.

matches.note: R6 identifies both the HAS_PARENT_ROLE gate and the findByIdAndParentId ownership lookup locking out self-registered players from completing homework.
R7 describes the same mechanism: swallowed DataIntegrityViolationException after flush marks the transaction rollback-only, yielding UnexpectedRollbackException/500 instead of idempotent 200.
R2 states the same role mismatch: ROLE_PLAYER accounts get 403 on /player/uploads/initiate, /my and /quotas/me because only ROLE_USER (and ROLE_COACH) are admitted.

R1 covers the VideoResource side (user id used as PlayerProfile id → profile lookup 403, wrong id space for quotas/lists) and R4 covers VideoAccessGuard.isOwner never matching a player's own video; together they cover the full defect.
R3 identifies the same isCurrentUserOwner bug: coach UUID compared to username so coaches get 403 on /events and /status, and the Long branch fails for self-registered players.
R5 identifies the HAS_PARENT_ROLE gate on subscribe/changeTier/cancel contradicting the service's self-ownership acceptance, so players can read but not mutate their subscription.
